title: Page 7
content_zh:
言待榆懒懒的爬起来，手撑着地板，看了她几秒，叹口气后又躺了回去。
“大鱼——”罗曼曼有些生气的将她拉起来。
言待榆在好友的瞪视下，有些不自在道：“如果一对男女朋友交往，假如女方做错事，男方不开心，说要跟你分手，你会怎么处理？”
“道歉。”
“道歉已经没用了。”
“所以殷先生吵架了吗？”
“谁说我跟他吵架了，我这只是假设问题。”看罗曼曼一脸的不信样，“对啦——我跟他闹翻了，你还不快点帮我想办法。”
她叹口气，“我只希望至少还能跟他是朋友，而不是像现在这样都不联络。”
她好讨厌这样感觉。
“那就跟他说，虽然当不成情侣，但我希望我们还是能当很好的朋友，这样不行吗？”罗曼曼认真的问。
言待榆认真的记下。
“你不想复合吗？”
“我想先从做朋友开始。”然后这一次，她要依照正常的交往程序走，即使是她倒追他也不所谓。
“那你快点打电话给他。”罗曼曼催促道。
“可是这样会不会太窝囊了？”她言待榆的一世英名，可不想落人口舌。
“如果是真心喜欢的人，我觉得那很值得啊！”罗曼曼又道：“再说你向来不是都把脸皮置于度外吗？”
“也是，我大鱼才不是这么放不开的人。”但每次对上殷策，总是觉得别扭了一些，少了她平时的帅气，好讨厌！
言待榆的想法一定，决心快速解决这个烦人的问题，她翻出手机，按下熟悉的号码。
她可以感觉到手心在冒汗，当电话被接起的那一刻，她仿佛听到自己的心跳声，“喂？殷策吗？”
“嗯。”殷策关掉电视——她终于打电话来了。

“我是言待榆。”
“我知道，有什么事吗？”他故作冷淡的问。
看罗曼曼深吸一口气，她也跟着深吸了一口气，“我要向你道歉，对不起。”
“嗯。”然后呢？殷策很期待她之后的话。
“我希望我们还是能当很好朋友。”罗曼曼很贴心的帮她到处捏捏捶捶，让言待榆也慢慢的放松了心情。
“朋友？”他突然有种很不好的预感。
“嗯。”她冷静下来，“我想跟你重新开始。”
“你的重新开始是指什么？”
“我们就从朋友开始做起，所以离婚的事要先办一办，看你什么时候有空，我们好好谈一谈。”
“抱歉，我没空。”他冷冷道。
意外被他打断，这让她的脑袋变得一片空白，一时不知该接什么，只能再次问道：“你不愿意吗？”
“不愿意。”
“哦！再见。”她沮丧的挂上电话，无力的躺回地上，手遮着眼睛。“他果然不原谅我……曼曼，我的心情好糟。”
可不知为何，罗曼曼却是面无表情。
“你怎么不说话？”她抬起头，看了罗曼曼一眼。
“大鱼，你结婚了喔？”罗曼曼闷闷的问。
“对。”却是一桩既短暂又可笑的婚姻！
“我要回去了。”罗曼曼一脸受打击的模样。
“你干嘛回去？”急忙爬起来，她还有很多事要找罗曼曼聊。
“我还以为我们是好朋友。”

“我们是啊！”言待榆突然警觉到有点不对劲，“怎么了吗？”她、她说错了什么吗？
“你为什么要瞒着我结婚的事？”
“我……我……不是故意要瞒你的，我只是、只是觉得没必要。”她有些慌了。
罗曼曼红了眼眶，一脸受伤的看着她，“大鱼，我真的好伤心，对你也好失望。”说完，情绪低落的离开。
言待榆的心情顿时跌到谷底，罗曼曼也生气了，她该怎么办……
殷策瞪着手机，这女人直到第五天才打电话给他，还劈头就问他何时要签离婚证书，她是故意想让他发火吗？
他在生气，她就不能再安抚他一下吗？
他一说要离婚，她便爽快的答应，一点挽回的意愿也没有，这样她敢说要跟他重新开始？算她够狠！
叮咚、叮咚——
殷策皱起眉头——他的心境正处于极度恶劣的状态，谁还会这么不识相的过来送死？
火大的开门，看到言待榆一脸快要哭出来的样子，他的心里一喜——原来她的心里还是在意着他的。
“罗曼曼生气了，怎么办？”她焦急的问。
瞬间的喜悦被浇灭，他哪会知道该怎么办，而且罗曼曼生气，关他屁事？
“罗曼曼是我的好朋友，我们认识很久了，这是她第一次这么生气，她都不接我电话，也不理我！”她着急道。
“你先进来吧！”他叹口气，至少她还愿意找他商量。
言待榆慌张的抓住他的手，“她该不会是想跟我绝交吧？”
“罗曼曼为什么会生气？”他安抚的拍拍她的手，让她坐好。
“她气我瞒她结婚的事。”她一脸的不安，“我只是觉得，这种错误的婚姻没什么好说的。”
殷策尽量要自己别去计较她的情绪化用词。
“怎么办？”

“她现在正在气头上，过几天你再去向她道歉就没事了。”怎样？她是有听懂没？只要她向他再道个歉就会没事，他俩是不必重新开始的。
“真的吗？可是罗曼曼很少在生气的，我怕她会一直躲我。”
“这证明她的脾气很好，没多久就会原谅你了。”而他也一样！
她松了一口气，不好意思的看向他，“是我太紧张了。”
她真的很过分——他生气时也没看她有这种反应，“你今天来找我，就是为了这件事吗？”
“对……”她老实道，直到看到他的面色不悦，这才发觉自己的唐突，“不好意思，那我回去了。”她觉得有些丢脸，她竟然跑来问“准前夫”和朋友吵架该怎么办……
“你站住！”难道她对她自己的行为都不觉得太超过吗？
“还有事吗？”
“我们的事呢？罗曼曼的事比较重要，而我的事就无所谓了吗？”他吃味的问。
“那你要不要趁这个时候谈离婚的事？”她想不出找他还能有什么事。
“你是真的想离婚吗？”
“你不也想？”那天很生气的说要离婚的人是他耶！而她这个做错事的人是没有资格多说什么的。
他深吸一口气，也罢，这女人完全在状况外，他就先不跟她计较这么多。“你可以忘掉旧情，只当我是朋友吗？”
“可以啊！”她也有过情人变朋友的经验，就算对他放不下，她也会逼自己放下的。
没想到她的答案会是如此的洒脱，“我会找一天好好跟你谈的。”他面带微笑，心里却快气坏了！
“你现在没空吗？”她看他没在忙什么，反正择日不如撞日，把离婚赶快办一办，免得她一想到就心烦。
“我在忙。”
“那我不吵你了。”她怯声道。
看她离开，殷策的心情更定雪上加霜——还是因为罗曼曼的关系，这女人才会跑来找他，所以在她的心目中，罗曼曼比他可是重要多了；而他呢？根本就是个随时都可以变成朋友的可怜丈夫！
是他太过愚蠢，才会想让她主动想通。

第10章(1)
友情、爱情皆失意，言待榆感到前所未有的烦躁。
殷策骗人，说什么过几天就会没事了，可现在都快一星期了，罗曼曼还是没消息的，还有殷策也说不可能跟她当朋友，这让她更是觉得沮丧到了谷底。
外面是大雷雨，她的心情也在下大雷雨。
“上次我看到那个男人是你哥哥吗？他好眼熟。”林颜强全身湿透的拿着卫生纸擦脸。
content_en:
Yan Daiyu lazily got up, put his hands on the floor, looked at her for a few seconds, sighed and lay back down.
"Big Fish—" Romanman pulled her up angrily.
Under the glare of her friend, Yan Daiyu felt a little uncomfortable and said, "If a man and a woman are dating, and the woman does something wrong and the man is unhappy and says he wants to break up with you, how would you deal with it?"
"Apologise."
"Apologizing is no longer useful."
"So Mr. Yin had a fight?"
"Who said I had a quarrel with him? I'm just assuming." Seeing Romanman's disbelief, "That's right - I had a falling out with him, why don't you help me find a solution quickly."
She sighed, "I just hope that I can at least still be friends with him, instead of not being in contact with him like I am now."
She hated feeling like this.
"Then tell him that although we can't be a couple, I hope we can still be good friends. Isn't that okay?" Roman Man asked seriously.
Yan Daiyu wrote it down carefully.
"Don't you want to get back together?"
"I want to start by being friends." Then this time, she will follow the normal dating procedures, even if she pursues him, it doesn't matter.
"Then call him quickly." Romanman urged.
"But wouldn't this be too cowardly?" She said that Yu's reputation would last forever, but she didn't want it to be offended.
"If you really like someone, I think it's worth it!" Romanman added, "Besides, haven't you always put your face aside?"
"That's right, I, Da Yu, am not such a person who can't let go." But every time I faced Yin Ce, I always felt a little awkward, missing her usual handsomeness, so annoying!
Yan Daiyu was convinced and determined to solve this annoying problem quickly. She took out her mobile phone and pressed a familiar number.
She could feel her palms sweating. When the phone was picked up, she seemed to hear her own heartbeat, "Hello? Are you Yin Ce?"
"Yeah." Yin Ce turned off the TV - she finally called.
"I am Yan Taiyu."
"I know, what's the matter?" he asked pretending to be cold.
Seeing Romanman take a deep breath, she also took a deep breath and said, "I want to apologize to you. I'm sorry."
"Hmm." What then? Yin Ce was looking forward to what she would say next.
"I hope we can still be good friends." Luo Manman was very considerate and helped her pinch and beat her everywhere, which made Yan Taiyu slowly relax.
"Friend?" He suddenly had a very bad feeling.
"Yeah." She calmed down, "I want to start over with you."
"What do you mean by starting over?"
"We'll start as friends, so we need to settle the divorce first. Let's have a good talk when you are free."
"Sorry, I'm not free." He said coldly.
Being interrupted unexpectedly by him made her mind go blank. She didn't know what to answer for a moment, so she could only ask again: "Don't you want to?"
"I don't want to."
"Oh! Goodbye." She hung up the phone in frustration and lay back on the ground weakly, covering her eyes with her hands. "He really doesn't forgive me... Manman, I'm in such a bad mood."
But for some reason, Luo Manman's face was expressionless.
"Why don't you speak?" She raised her head and glanced at Romanman.
"Big Fish, are you married?" Romanman asked dully.
"Yes." But it was a short and ridiculous marriage!
"I'm going back." Romanman looked shocked.
"Why are you going back?" She hurriedly got up. She still had many things to talk to Romanman about.
"I thought we were good friends."
"We are!" Yan Taiyu suddenly realized something was wrong, "What's wrong?" Did she, did she say something wrong?
"Why did you hide the marriage from me?"
"I...I...didn't mean to hide it from you, I just, I just didn't think it was necessary." She panicked.
Romanman's eyes were red,He looked at her with a hurt look on his face and said, "Big Fish, I'm really sad and disappointed in you." After saying that, he left emotionally.
Yan Taiyu's mood suddenly hit rock bottom, and Luo Manman was also angry. What should she do...
Yin Ce stared at the phone. This woman didn't call him until the fifth day, and she immediately asked him when he was going to sign the divorce certificate. Was she deliberately trying to make him angry?
He was angry, couldn't she comfort him again?
As soon as he said he wanted a divorce, she readily agreed without any intention of taking it back. How dare she say that she wanted to start over with him? She is cruel enough!
Ding dong, ding dong——
Yin Ce frowned - he was in an extremely bad state of mind, who would come here to die so ignorantly?
He opened the door angrily, and when he saw Yan Taiyu looking like he was about to cry, he felt happy - it turned out that she still cared about him in her heart.
"Romanman is angry, what should I do?" she asked anxiously.
The instant joy was extinguished, how could he know what to do, and it was none of his business if Romanman was angry?
"Romanman is a good friend of mine. We have known each other for a long time. This is the first time that she has been so angry. She doesn't answer my calls or pay attention to me!" she said anxiously.
"You come in first!" He sighed, at least she was willing to discuss it with him.
Yan Daiyu grabbed his hand in panic, "Does she want to break up with me?"
"Why is Romanman angry?" He patted her hand comfortingly and asked her to sit down.
"She was angry that I hid the marriage from her." She looked uneasy, "I just think there is nothing good to say about this wrong marriage."
Yin Ce tried his best not to worry about her emotional words.
"What to do?"
"She's angry right now. If you go and apologize to her in a few days, she'll be fine." What? Did she understand? As long as she apologizes to him again it will be fine and they don't have to start over.
"Really? But Luo Manman rarely gets angry. I'm afraid she will keep avoiding me."
"This proves that she has a good temper and will forgive you soon." And he does the same!
She breathed a sigh of relief and looked at him sheepishly, "I'm too nervous."
She really went too far - he didn't see her react like this when he was angry, "Is this why you came to me today?"
"Yes..." she said honestly. It wasn't until she saw his unhappy expression that she realized how abrupt she was, "Sorry, I'll go back then." She felt a little embarrassed, and she actually came to ask her "quasi-ex-husband" what to do if he had a quarrel with his friends...
"Stop!" Doesn't she feel that her own behavior is too much?
"Is there anything else?"
"What about our affairs? Romanman's affairs are more important, but mine don't matter?" he asked in amusement.
"Then do you want to take this opportunity to talk about divorce?" She couldn't think of anything else to do with him.
"Do you really want a divorce?"
"Don't you want it too?" He was the one who said angrily that day that he wanted a divorce! And she, who had done something wrong, was not qualified to say anything.
He took a deep breath. Anyway, this woman was completely out of the situation, so he wouldn't care about her so much. "Can you forget the old relationship and just treat me as a friend?"
"Okay!" She also had the experience of a lover turning into a friend. Even if she couldn't let go of him, she would force herself to let him go.
He didn't expect her answer to be so free and easy, "I will talk to you one day." He was smiling, but he was almost furious!
"Aren't you free now?" She saw that he was not busy with anything. Anyway, it would be better to hit the right date and get the divorce done as soon as possible, so as not to upset her at the thought of it.
"I'm busy."
"Then I won't bother you." She said timidly.
Seeing her leave, Yin Ce's mood became even worse - it was because of Romanman that this woman came to him, so in her mind, Romanman was better than him.It's much more important; and what about him? He is simply a poor husband who can become a friend at any time!
It was because he was so stupid that he wanted her to figure it out on her own initiative.
Chapter 10(1)
Friendship and love are all frustrated, and Yan Taiyu feels more irritable than ever.
Yin Ce lied, saying that he would be fine in a few days, but it was almost a week now, and there was still no news about Romanman. Yin Ce also said that it was impossible for him to be friends with her, which made her feel even more depressed.
There was a thunderstorm outside, and she was also in a thunderstorm mood.
"Is that man I saw last time your brother? He looks familiar." Lin Yanqiang was soaked and wiped his face with toilet paper.
